name: Laravel
summary: A PHP framework for full web apps, with pages, a database layer, queues and login tools built in.

free_plan_covers.note: Free and open source under the MIT license. You pay only for hosting.

first_paid_usd_month.note: No paid plan. The framework itself is free.

portability.note: Runs on any server with PHP, behind Nginx or FrankenPHP, not only on Laravel's own hosting.

language.note: Written in PHP, with Blade templates for pages.

has_server_code.note: Routes and controllers run only on the server, so secrets stay private.

uses_react.note: Pages use Blade templates by default. A React starter kit exists, but React is optional.

setup.step: Create the app with laravel new and push it to a GitHub repository. The installer copies .env.example to .env.

builder_notes: Settings live in the .env file, which is never committed. Call env() only inside files in the config folder, and use config() everywhere else, because env() stops reading .env after config:cache.
Set APP_DEBUG to false in production.
